summary: Fresh-context agent steps no longer receive the predecessor's automatic handoff message

replay.detail: Existing fresh-context requests and runtime observations identify the reset and replacement. No claim kinds or fields change.

schema.detail: No database or serialized model changes.

rules.detail: Authorization, mailbox access and run ownership are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: A replacement for a fresh-context step or seat policy no longer receives the session-start handoff, unfinished-work summary or unread-mail summary from its predecessor. Ordinary restarts retain continuity, including a later ordinary restart after a fresh reset. Fresh context remains opt-in because standing workers intentionally retain conversation across ordinary steps. Independent turns use a separate run-owned agent subject plus fresh-context; one-shot only controls retirement, and a standing seat's mailbox is not erased.

downtime.detail: No migration or forced agent restart.

manual.detail: No manual action required. Mission and program-worker documentation describes the existing native isolation recipe.

recovery.detail: Rolling back restores automatic predecessor handoff delivery after fresh resets; stored handoffs and messages are unchanged.
